# Scenario: project-local relative file/dir binds are allowed, synced from Git,
# rewritten to absolute host paths under infra/apps/<project>/, and always
# forced read-only (short :rw and long read_only: false overridden). Named
# volumes stay writable. README Strict Volume & Socket Control.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: project-local bind fixtures'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
! stderr 'security_violation'
! stderr 'disallowed_bind_mount'

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-plbind-web

exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/docker-compose.yml
exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/config.txt
exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/extra.txt
exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/rules/a.txt
grep 'hello-config' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/config.txt
grep 'rule-a' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/rules/a.txt

# Generated compose: absolute sources under apps/<project> + read_only on binds.
grep 'read_only: true' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/docker-compose.yml
grep 'e2e-plbind/config.txt' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/docker-compose.yml
grep 'e2e-plbind/rules' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/docker-compose.yml
grep 'e2e-plbind/extra.txt' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/docker-compose.yml
grep 'type: volume' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/docker-compose.yml
grep 'source: data' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/docker-compose.yml

# Bind assets must be world-readable for non-root container UIDs.
exec sh -c 'mode=$(stat -f %Lp "$HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/config.txt" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %a "$HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/config.txt"); echo "config_mode=$mode"; test "$mode" = "644"'
exec sh -c 'mode=$(stat -f %Lp "$HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/rules" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %a "$HOME/infra/apps/e2e-plbind/rules"); echo "rules_mode=$mode"; test "$mode" = "755"'

# Runtime mounts are read-only (RW=false), including sources that asked for :rw.
exec sh -c 'cid=$(docker ps -q --filter name=apinfra_e2e-plbind-web); test -n "$cid"; docker inspect -f "{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Destination .RW}}{{end}}" "$cid" | tee mounts.txt; grep "/etc/app/config.txt false" mounts.txt; grep "/etc/app/rules false" mounts.txt; grep "/etc/app/extra.txt false" mounts.txt'

! exists $HOME/.events

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-plbind
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9982
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-plbind/config.txt --
hello-config

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-plbind/extra.txt --
hello-extra

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-plbind/rules/a.txt --
rule-a

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-plbind/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    volumes:
      - ./config.txt:/etc/app/config.txt
      - ./rules:/etc/app/rules:rw
      - type: bind
        source: ./extra.txt
        target: /etc/app/extra.txt
        read_only: false
      - data:/data
volumes:
  data:

-- .env --
